classes.name: contractual control

classes.definition: control established through the terms of some contract

classes.name: controlled party
classes.label: controlled party

classes.name: controlling alliance
classes.label: controlling alliance
classes.definition: group that has formed some alliance to jointly exercise control over some entity

classes.name: court appointed control
classes.label: court appointed control
classes.definition: control conferred by the actions of some court, for example in the context of receivership

classes.name: de facto controlling interest party
classes.label: de facto controlling interest party
classes.definition: party that exercises some control over an entity other than via explicit, legal means

classes.name: de jure controlling interest party
classes.label: de jure controlling interest party
classes.definition: party that has the legal authority to exercise control

classes.name: entity controlling party
classes.label: entity controlling party
classes.definition: party that has the authority to control some legal entity

classes.name: influence-based de facto control
classes.label: influence-based de facto control
classes.definition: informal control that involves influence over some party

classes.name: influence-based de facto controlling party
classes.label: influence-based de facto controlling party
classes.definition: party that holds influence-based control over some other party

classes.name: investment-based de facto control
classes.label: investment-based de facto control
classes.definition: control that arises through some investment in some entity, other than via the holding of constitutional equity (shares etc.) in that entity

rules.value: investment-based de facto controlling interest party

classes.name: investment-based de facto controlling interest party
classes.label: investment-based de facto controlling interest party

classes.name: joint controlling party
classes.label: joint controlling party

classes.name: majority controlling party
classes.label: majority controlling party

classes.name: receiver
classes.label: receiver
classes.definition: party appointed by some court for the purposes of winding up the affairs of some entity which is no longer solvent

classes.name: sole controlling party
classes.label: sole controlling party
classes.definition: party that has sole control over and directs the affairs of some legal entity

classes.name: total owner
classes.label: total owner

classes.name: affiliate
classes.label: affiliate

classes.name: affiliation
classes.label: affiliation
classes.definition: situation in which a controlled party is affiliated with a controlling party for some period of time

classes.name: controlled affiliate
classes.label: controlled affiliate
classes.definition: controlled party in an affiliation situation

classes.name: controlling affiliate
classes.label: controlling affiliate
classes.definition: controlling party in an affiliation situation

classes.name: domestic ultimate parent
classes.label: domestic ultimate parent
classes.definition: party that is recognized as the ultimate parent of a given organization within the country or jurisdiction of incorporation or organization

classes.name: global ultimate parent
classes.label: global ultimate parent
classes.definition: party that is recognized as the ultimate parent of a given organization world-wide

classes.name: joint venture partner
classes.label: joint venture partner

classes.name: significant shareholder
classes.label: significant shareholder

classes.name: subsidiary
classes.label: subsidiary

classes.name: total controlling interest party
classes.label: total controlling interest party

classes.name: voting shareholder
classes.label: voting shareholder

classes.name: beneficial owner
classes.label: beneficial owner
classes.definition: party that enjoys the benefits of ownership (such as receipt of income) of something even though its ownership (title) may be in the name of another party (called a nominee or registered owner)

classes.name: beneficial ownership
classes.label: beneficial ownership
classes.definition: situation linking party that enjoys the benefits of ownership (such as receipt of income) of something even though its ownership (title) may be in the name of another party (called a nominee or registered owner) to the asset that they own

classes.name: purchase lot
classes.label: purchase lot
classes.definition: financial asset that is a block of securities or other financial assets bought in one transaction on a given date at a specific price

classes.name: shareholder
classes.label: shareholder
classes.definition: party that owns shares in and has rights and responsibilities with respect to some asset, provided in exchange for investment

classes.name: shareholding
classes.label: shareholding
classes.definition: ownership interest in the equity of a company, represented by shares that confer financial rights and governance privileges

classes.name: tax lot
classes.label: tax lot
classes.definition: financial asset that is a block of securities or other financial assets with a distinct cost basis for tax reporting purposes

classes.name: articles of incorporation
classes.label: articles of incorporation

classes.name: auditor
classes.label: auditor
classes.definition: party qualified and authorized to review and verify the accuracy of financial records and ensure that companies comply with tax laws

classes.name: authorized individual
classes.label: authorized individual
classes.definition: role of an individual that has been given the responsibility to act on behalf of another party under some set of guidelines

classes.name: board capacity
classes.label: board capacity

classes.name: board composition control
classes.label: board composition control

classes.name: board member
classes.label: board member

classes.name: board membership
classes.label: board membership

classes.name: board of directors
classes.label: board of directors

classes.name: bylaws
classes.label: bylaws

classes.name: chief executive officer
classes.label: chief executive officer

classes.name: chief financial officer
classes.label: chief financial officer

classes.name: company law
classes.label: company law
classes.definition: legislation under which the formation, registration or incorporation, governance, and dissolution of a firm is administered and controlled

classes.name: company secretary
classes.label: company secretary

classes.name: controlling nominee
classes.label: controlling nominee

classes.name: corporate bylaws
classes.label: corporate bylaws
classes.definition: written rules for conduct of a corporation, adopted by the board of directors

classes.name: corporate officer
classes.label: corporate officer

classes.name: executive
classes.label: executive

classes.name: executive board member
classes.label: executive board member

classes.name: external auditor
classes.label: external auditor
classes.definition: independent party qualified and authorized to examine and report on the accuracy of financial records and ensure that companies comply with tax laws

classes.name: internal auditor
classes.label: internal auditor
classes.definition: employee who is qualified and authorized to review and verify the accuracy of financial records and evaluate internal controls and compliance

classes.name: non-executive board member
classes.label: non-executive board member

classes.name: principal party
classes.label: principal party

classes.name: signatory
classes.label: signatory
classes.definition: responsible party authorized to sign agreements on behalf of themselves, another person, or an organization

classes.name: constitutional owner
classes.label: constitutional owner
classes.definition: entity owner that holds an equity stake in said entity, in the form of shareholders' equity

classes.name: controlling equity
classes.label: controlling equity

classes.name: direct consolidation
classes.label: direct consolidation

classes.name: entity owner
classes.label: entity owner
classes.definition: owner (person, group of people, or other business entity) that owns, or holds an ownership interest in, a formal business organization

classes.name: entity ownership
classes.label: entity ownership
classes.definition: ownership by some party of an interest in some non-governmental formal organization

classes.name: foreign branch ownership
classes.label: foreign branch ownership
classes.definition: ownership by some party of some formal organization or organizational sub-unit that is a foreign affiliate and legally part of the owning entity

classes.name: investment equity
classes.label: investment equity
classes.definition: equity that represents an ownership interest in some entity, but may or may not take the form of shareholders's equity

classes.name: investor
classes.label: investor
classes.definition: party that owns some stake in some organization by way of investment

classes.name: investor contract
classes.label: investor contract
classes.definition: Contract setting out the terms under which some investor invests in the entity and setting out the rights which are conferred on that investor.

classes.name: ultimate ownership
classes.label: ultimate ownership
classes.definition: highest-level (top, end) ancestral ownership, evidenced by accounting consolidation, by some party of some other legal entity
